load_universal_poker_from_acpc_gamedef: load a universal poker game from an ACPC gamedef string using pyspiel.universal_poker
create_cfr_solver: create a CFR solver instance for a poker game with configurable iterations and solver type
evaluate_and_update_policy: run CFR evaluate_and_update_policy iterations to train the solver and reduce exploitability
measure_exploitability: measure the exploitability of a solver's average policy against optimal play
persist_and_load_solver: pickle dump and load a trained CFR solver to disk and verify its exploitability after reload
